# Edzy

> > India's largest online learning platform for CBSE/NCERT classes 6-12, offering interactive study materials, competitive quizzes, and comprehensive exam preparation.

Edzy provides personalized learning experiences through gamified features like Duel (competitive quiz battles) and structured CBSE curriculum coverage. The platform includes textbook-aligned study materials, practice tests, and revision guides across multiple subjects including English, Hindi, Mathematics, and ICT.

## Key Topics

- CBSE
- NCERT

## Core Platform

- [Edzy Homepage](https://www.edzy.ai): Homepage for Edzy, India's largest online learning platform for CBSE/NCERT classes 6-12.
- [Edzy Duel](https://www.edzy.ai/duel): Competitive CBSE/NCERT quiz battles and multiplayer challenges for gamified learning.

## Class 9 English

- [Class 9 English Overview](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-english): Class 9 English study materials, practice tests, and revision modules for CBSE exams.
- [Beehive Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-english-beehive): Beehive Class 9 English textbook with prose, poetry, and literary appreciation materials.
- [Moments Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-english-moments): Moments supplementary reader textbook with chapter summaries and literature study guides.
- [Words and Expressions - I](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-english-words-and-expressions-i): Words and Expressions workbook for Class 9 English vocabulary, grammar, and language skills.

## Class 9 Hindi

- [Class 9 Hindi Overview](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-hindi): Class 9 Hindi study materials with Sanchayan, Sparsh, Kshitij textbooks and practice tests.
- [Kshitij Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-hindi-kshitij): Kshitij Class 9 Hindi textbook with chapter summaries and literature study materials.
- [Sparsh Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-hindi-sparsh): Sparsh Class 9 Hindi textbook with prose and poetry for CBSE Hindi curriculum.
- [Sanchayan Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-hindi-sanchayan): Sanchayan supplementary Hindi textbook with prose, poetry, and literature study guides.
- [Kritika Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-hindi-kritika): Kritika supplementary Hindi textbook with literature study and chapter guides.

## Class 9 Mathematics & Science

- [Class 9 Mathematics Overview](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-mathematics): Class 9 Mathematics study materials with NCERT content, interactive lessons, and practice tests.
- [Mathematics Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-mathematics-book): Class 9 Mathematics textbook with algebra, geometry, and comprehensive problem solutions.

## Class 9 Other Subjects

- [Class 9 Health and Physical Education](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-health-and-physical-education): Class 9 Health and Physical Education study materials with practice quizzes and exam prep.
- [Health and Physical Education Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-health-and-physical-education-book): Health and Physical Education textbook covering wellness, fitness, yoga, and sports ethics.
- [Class 9 ICT](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-ict): Class 9 ICT study materials covering digital literacy, computer fundamentals, and cybersecurity.
- [Information and Communication Technology Textbook](https://www.edzy.ai/cbse-class-9-ict-information-and-communication-technology): ICT textbook with multimedia, cybersecurity, presentation skills, and internet safety.
